items.question: Who should recite all mantras again after performing the great inner sacrifice?
premises: The sacrifice-doer is a great yogi.
items.inference: The great yogi repeats all mantras after sacrifice.
uncertainties: Exact ritual sequence is not fully specified by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: The great yogi who performs the sacrifice should recite all mantras again.
